props.label: Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities

name: Golden Goose Egg
text: Gain souls over time, as long as you are alive.

name: Mystic Burst
text: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, causing abilities dealing more than 80 damage to deal additional damage.

name: Mystic Expansion
text: Imbue an ability to increase its range and effect radius.

name: Mystic Regeneration
text: Dealing spirit damage to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus regeneration. Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes.

name: Rusted Barrel
text: Target an enemy to reduce their Fire Rate and Bullet Resistance.

name: Spirit Strike
text:
When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, deal extra spirit damage with the attack and reduce the target's Spirit Resist.

Cooldown is 2x longer for Light Melee hits.

name: Arcane Surge
text: After you Dash-Jump, the next ability you use within 7s will have bonus Range, Duration, and Spirit Power.

name: Bullet Resist Shredder
text: Reduces Bullet Resist on enemies when you deal spirit damage.

name: Cold Front
text: Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage and Slows targets it hits.

name: Compress Cooldown
text: Imbue an ability to reduce its Cooldown.

name: Duration Extender
text: Imbue an ability to increase its Duration.

name: Mystic Slow
text: When the target takes spirit damage, they have their Move Speed reduced.

name: Mystic Vulnerability
text: When an enemy takes spirit damage, they have their spirit resist reduced.

name: Quicksilver Reload
text: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use.

name: Slowing Hex
text:
Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities.
Increases the target's gravity.
Does not affect target's stamina usage.

name: Spirit Sap
text: Target an enemy to reduce their Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.

name: Suppressor
text: When you deal spirit damage to enemies, you also reduce their Fire Rate.

name: Decay
text:
Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health.
Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

name: Disarming Hex
text: Disarms enemy target and reduces their Bullet Resist.

name: Greater Expansion
text: Increases the range and effect radius of your abilities and items.

name: Knockdown
text:
Apply a Stun after 2s. Stun duration is increased against airborne targets.

Increases the target's gravity for the duration of the stun.

name: Radiant Regeneration
text: While in-combat, Heal and gain bonus Movement Speed for a short duration when you cast an ability.

props.label: Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities

name: Silence Wave
text:
Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage.

Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.

name: Spirit Snatch
text:
When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, the attack deals extra spirit damage and steals Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.

Effects are reduced by 30% for Light Melee hits.

name: Superior Cooldown
text: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities.

name: Superior Duration
text: Increases the duration of your abilities and items.

name: Surge of Power
text: Imbue an ability with permanent Spirit Power. When that ability is used, gain bonus Move Speed and maintain full speed while attacking.

name: Tankbuster
text: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, causing abilities dealing more than 165 damage to deal additional damage. Ignores Spirit Resistance.

name: Torment Pulse
text: Periodically deals spirit damage to the closest two enemies nearby.

name: Arctic Blast
text:
Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage, Freezing and then Slowing targets it hits.

Slowed targets have their stamina regen frozen

name: Cursed Relic
text:
Curses an enemy - interrupting, Silencing, Disarming, and preventing item usage. Removes all non-ultimate buffs.

Your own Damage Output is reduced for the duration.

name: Echo Shard
text:
Reset the cooldown of the imbued non-ultimate ability.

This item's cooldown is increased by the cooldown of the imbued ability.

name: Escalating Exposure
text: Dealing spirit damage applies a stacking Spirit Amp that increases your spirit damage to the target.

name: Ethereal Shift
text: Instantly enter a void state and become Invulnerable for a short duration.

name: Focus Lens
text: Target an enemy to Silence them. A portion of all damage dealt during the silence gets applied to the target when the silence wears off.

name: Lightning Scroll
text: Damage from your ultimate applies a stun and deals bonus spirit damage after a short delay.

name: Magic Carpet
text:
Summon a Magic Carpet that will fly you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet.
Cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned.

name: Mercurial Magnum
text: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use. Until your next reload, your bullets deal bonus spirit damage based on your Spirit Power.

name: Mystic Reverb
text: Imbue an ability with Lifesteal and to apply slow on a hit target and deal an additional percentage of the damage dealt to enemies around the target after a short delay.

name: Refresher
text: Reset the cooldown of all your abilities and restore all your charges.

name: Scourge
text:
Apply Spirit Resist, Debuff Resist and an aura on a friendly target that deals damage to enemies proportional to their max health. Existing debuffs on the target are reduced.
Can be self cast.

name: Spirit Burn
text:
Dealing significant spirit damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing.
The cooldown is per enemy, so each target can only be burned once per cooldown. Deals half-damage on non-heroes.

name: Transcendent Cooldown
text: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities and items.

name: Vortex Web
text:
Throw a vacuum grenade, pulling all enemies into a small area and applying Slowing Hex.

Alt Cast to Target Unit Directly.

name: Grit
text: Gain a Barrier for a short duration.

name: Healing Rite
text: Grant Regen and Sprint Speed to the target. Gets dispelled if you take damage from enemy players or objectives. Can be self-cast.

name: Melee Lifesteal
text:
Your next Melee attack heals you.

This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes.
Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

name: Rebuttal
text: On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.

name: Battle Vest
text: While you are above 65% health, gain weapon damage and bonus fire rate.

name: Debuff Reducer
text: Reduces the duration of all negative effects applied to you.

name: Enchanter's Emblem
text: While you are above 65% health, gain bonus Spirit and Cooldown Reduction.

name: Enduring Speed
text: Reduces the effect of enemy Move Speed penalties.

name: Guardian Ward
text:
Provide the target with a Barrier and temporary Move Speed.
Can be self-cast.
Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

name: Healbane
text: Your spirit damage reduces the enemy's Incoming Healing. If an enemy hero dies under this effect, you receive a large heal.

name: Healing Booster
text: Increases the effectiveness of your healing.

name: Reactive Barrier
text: Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced.

name: Restorative Locket
text:
When an enemy uses an ability within 32mm range from you, store one Restoration Stack.

Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to 3 stamina based on how many stacks you have.

name: Return Fire
text: Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.

name: Spirit Shielding
text: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant spirit damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

name: Trophy Collector
text: Whenever you score an assist or kill, gain extra sprint, ability range and passive soul generation. This effect stacks and persists through death.

name: Weapon Shielding
text: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant weapon damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

name: Bullet Resilience
text: When below 50% health, gain additional Bullet Resist.

name: Counterspell
text: Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items. On a successful spell parry heal and gain move speed and Spirit.

name: Dispel Magic
text:
Purge all non-ultimate negative effects currently applied to you. If any effects were removed, heal yourself and gain a move speed bonus.
Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

name: Fortitude
text: After not taking damage for a period, gain health regen.

name: Fury Trance
text: Grants Fire Rate, Spirit Resistance and Move Speed, and removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting, but Silences you and disables stamina usage and regeneration.

name: Healing Nova
text: Heal yourself and nearby allies.

name: Lifestrike
text:
Your Melee Attack applies Movement Slow and heals you for a percentage of the Melee Damage dealt plus a fixed amount.

This heal is 40% effective vs non-heroes.
Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

name: Majestic Leap
text:
Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier. While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster.

Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by enemy Hero.

name: Metal Skin
text: Become immune to bullets.

name: Rescue Beam
text: Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health. Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.

name: Spirit Resilience
text: When below 50% health, gain additional Spirit Resist.

name: Stamina Mastery
text: Allows an additional use of Air Jump or Air Dash before landing.

name: Veil Walker
text: Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth, Heal and increased Move Speed.

name: Warp Stone
text: Teleport straight ahead, gaining Bullet Resist.

name: Cheat Death
text:
When you would take lethal damage, instead become temporarily death immune and remove all non-stun debuffs.

While death immune, you deal reduced damage and have reduced healing.

name: Colossus
text:
Grow larger in size, gaining bullet resist, spirit resist, and melee damage.

Nearby enemies suffer from slow and have reduced dash speed.

name: Divine Barrier
text:
Remove all non-stun debuffs from the target and provide them with a Barrier and Move Speed.
Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

name: Diviner's Kevlar
text: Upon casting an ultimate ability gain a Barrier and temporary Spirit Power.

name: Healing Tempo
text:
Applying heal to yourself or an ally grants the target bonus fire rate and bonus move speed.

Does not apply on innate Regen or passive Bullet/Spirit Lifesteals.

name: Indomitable
text: The next Stun, Chain, Immobilize, Sleep, Silence or Fear is automatically cleansed. When this happens, you gain a barrier and all your ability cooldowns get reduced by 20%.

name: Infuser
text: Gain Spirit Lifesteal and Spirit Power.

name: Inhibitor
text: Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction.

name: Juggernaut
text: Enemies that shoot you have their Fire Rate slowed.

name: Leech
text: Reduces the effect of enemy applied healing reduction.

name: Phantom Strike
text: Teleport to an enemy target and pull them to the ground. Dealing damage, Move speed reduction and Disarm.

name: Plated Armor
text: Gain a chance to either deflect incoming bullets, preventing all weapon damage or prevent all on-hit effects from bullets.

name: Siphon Bullets
text: Your bullets temporarily steal Max HP from enemies. Enemies regain their stolen health when the debuff expires.

name: Spellbreaker
text: The next instance of high spirit damage you take is significantly reduced.

name: Unstoppable
text:
Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm.
Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

name: Vampiric Burst
text: Grants Lifesteal, Fire Rate, and Ammo. This added Ammo is not limited by your max magazine size.

name: Witchmail
text: Taking heavy hits of spirit damage from an enemy reduces a random ability cooldown.

name: Close Quarters
text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when in close range to your target.

name: Headshot Booster
text: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage.

name: Restorative Shot
text: Your next bullet will heal you based on what target you hit.

name: Active Reload
text: While reloading, pressing Reload during the highlighted portion will instantly finish your reload and grant you Fire Rate, Bullet Lifesteal and Move Speed.

name: Fleetfoot
text: Removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting.

name: Intensifying Magazine
text: Increases Weapon Damage as you continuously fire your weapon.

name: Kinetic Dash
text: When you Dash-Jump you gain Fire Rate and bonus Ammo until your next reload. Lasts up to 7s.

name: Long Range
text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

name: Melee Charge
text: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.

name: Mystic Shot
text: Your next bullet deals bonus spirit damage.

name: Opening Rounds
text: Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health.

name: Recharging Rush
text: Dealing significant weapon damage replenishes a charge for each of your charged abilities.

name: Slowing Bullets
text: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

name: Spirit Shredder
text: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

name: Split Shot
text:
Make your weapon fire multishot.

Hitting more than one Hero per attack will grant a stacking weapon damage bonus.

Targets can only be hit once per multishot.

name: Stalker
text:
Dealing weapon damage at close range opens a wound and grants you bonus move speed.

Wounded enemies take spirit damage over time, have reduced bullet resist, and are revealed through walls.

name: Weakening Headshot
text: Landing a Headshot reduces their Bullet Resist.

name: Alchemical Fire
text:
Throw a flask that explodes on contact, creating an area that does increasing spirit damage per second and reduces enemy Bullet Resist.

50% less effective vs non-heroes.

name: Ballistic Enchantment
text: Imbue an ability with increased range. Dealing damage with that ability grants you increased weapon damage per unique hero hit. Has reduced effect on non-heroes.

name: Berserker
text: Your Weapon Damage increases as you take sustained damage.

name: Blood Tribute
text: Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve fire rate, Debuff Resistance and Move Speed.

name: Burst Fire
text: Briefly gain Fire Rate and Move Speed when one of your bullets hits a hero.

name: Cultist Sacrifice
text: Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 170% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.

name: Escalating Resilience
text: Grants Bullet Resist when your bullets hit a hero. Each shot can only grant one stack.

name: Express Shot
text: Your next attack will fire twice in quick succession with increased damage and velocity. This attack consumes extra ammo.

name: Headhunter
text: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage, heal you, and briefly grants bonus move speed.

name: Heroic Aura
text: Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units.

name: Hollow Point
text: When you are above 65% health, deal additional Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist.

name: Hunter's Aura
text: Reduces nearby enemies' Bullet Resist and Fire Rate. If there is only one enemy hero nearby, this effect is doubled.

name: Point Blank
text: When in close range to your target, gain Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a Movement Slow.

name: Shadow Weave
text: Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed.

name: Sharpshooter
text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

name: Spirit Rend
text: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

name: Tesla Bullets
text: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

name: Toxic Bullets
text: Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also reduces Incoming Healing on the bleeding target.

name: Weighted Shots
text: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

name: Armor Piercer
text: Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.

name: Capacitor
text: Launch a projectile that deals damage, applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities.

name: Crippling Headshot
text: Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet, Spirit Resist, and Incoming Healing.

name: Crushing Fists
text:
Your melee damage will restore ammo and apply a stacking bullet resist debuff on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks.

If the target reaches max stacks, they will be stunned.

name: Frenzy
text: While you are below 50% health, you gain stat bonuses for a duration and existing debuffs on you are reduced.

name: Glass Cannon
text: Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

name: Lucky Shot
text:
Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit.
Bonus damage cannot Crit.

name: Ricochet
text: Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.

name: Silencer
text: Your bullets build up to a Silence. Victims are immune to the build up for 10s after silence expires.

name: Spellslinger
text:
While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed.
Each stack refreshes the duration.

name: Spiritual Overflow
text: Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting heroes.
